items.title: CF Industries Stock Touches New Record on Fertilizer Supply Crunch
items.summary: CF Industries, which makes nitrogen fertilizer, hit its first new record closing high since March today. This marks the company's fifth consecutive winning day; prices rose 11% over this period. The war in Iran has choked off supplies of liquefied natural gas, or LNG, which is used to produce nitrogen fertilizers.

items.title: Fertilizer Giants Ready New Plants to Boost U.S. Supplies
items.summary: ​Fertilizer companies are revving their engines to boost supplies of crop nutrients that have been squeezed by the war in the Middle East.  CF Industries, the largest U.S. producer of nitrogen fertilizer, broke ground yesterday on a $4 billion plant.  Separately, farmer co-op CHS and fertilizer maker OCP North America said they plan to build a $450 million production facility focused on phosphate fertilizer.
